selection_means: Best available within one corrective regeneration per view; not acceptance as compliant texture source.

runs.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Produce exactly one 1024 x 1024 transparent PNG texture-source painting, FRONT view.
Input 1 guide_front.png is the EDIT TARGET and absolute pixel geometry authority, not an inspiration. Input 2 design_reference.png is only the material and colour reference. Input 3 concept_crop.png is supporting concept reference.
Paint directly over the plain grey front orthographic render, preserving its alpha silhouette EXACTLY, its position, size, projection, all outlines, every beam edge, every opening and negative space, each fabric edge and every existing detail. Keep the guide's exact front view. Do not substitute the reference's three-quarter camera or geometry. No additions, deletions, straightening, recentering, cropping or reshaping.
Apply rust-brown and dark grey salvaged steel to the girders and sheets, aged rust mottling, faded red-brown worn tarp fabric, earthy grey rubble at existing feet, and warm amber colour to the existing lantern. Derive surface appearance from the approved design, but do not add its holes, ropes, rivets or structures where they would alter guide geometry. No people or scenery.
LIGHTING: unlit albedo texture source; even flat shadowless illumination from viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Paint the lantern's glowing colour without bloom or light cast on surroundings. Do not retain the guide's grey lighting as baked shadows. Material variation only.
The background and all existing open spaces must be genuine alpha transparency. No backdrop, floor, text or grid. Keep exactly 1024 x 1024 framing of guide_front.png. Output one image only.
runs.reason: Superseded by correction: framing and edges drifted; extra tarp holes and baked lighting. Tool returned [1254, 1254] despite the explicit 1024x1024 request; preserved unresized.
